name: CivilTime-Bench
description: CivilTime-Bench evaluates a model's ability to reason about civil time concepts such as time-zone conversion, daylight saving adjustments, date arithmetic, and scheduling across locales. Tasks probe both factual knowledge (time zone rules) and procedural reasoning (computing local times, durations, and next/previous occurrences). The benchmark emphasizes correctness of computed times and clear handling of edge cases like DST transitions.
reputation: A niche, task-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used by researchers studying temporal reasoning; adoption is limited but grows among temporal/QA communities.
